title: Neco Arc Totem
description: This texture pack adds an immortality totem to the game in the form of a Neco Arc character in 64x64 resolution with its own sounds and custom names!
body: This texture pack adds an immortality totem to the game in the form of a Neco Arc character in 64x64 resolution with its own sounds and custom names! The character will sit cute on your arm while waving at you, and in case of your possible death, it will save you with a cool sound!
